subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should the remaining Control UI channel-session work stop at the current Group by Channel table mode, stay as this issue’s separated/merged timeline request, or be folded into the broader sessions workspace design?
rationale: Current main partially solves channel organization, but a true merged timeline or tabbed channel view requires maintainer decisions about UX, privacy, transcript aggregation, and reply routing semantics.

options.title: Keep And Scope This Issue
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical channel-view toggle thread and define separated view, merged timeline, and routing/privacy semantics before implementation.

options.title: Treat Grouping As Enough
options.body: Close the remaining request if maintainers decide the current Group by Channel table plus per-session chat links is the intended Control UI surface.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Move the remaining work under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 if one broader sessions workspace should own channel views, peek, inline reply, and status semantics.

recommendation.title: Keep And Scope This Issue
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical channel-view toggle thread and define separated view, merged timeline, and routing/privacy semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest current-main implementation and docs update for channel grouping came through steipete’s recent Control UI sessions work.
